steps.content: [Phanuel's Mansion]
Ten hours have passed since you were bound here, completely cut off from the outside world. Phanuel's concert is less than half a day away.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Great. Triangle Face isn't here. Can't even chat with someone to pass the time.
You shift around, trying to make the restraints a little more bearable.

Ten hours. Since Schorl still hasn't been able to pinpoint your location, that can only mean whoever's behind this has accounted for every communication channel the Bureau has. Including the backup ones.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Mirrormoon Entertainment... registered two years ago. Eliza's both the owner and legal representative. Phanuel's their only artist, and the entire company's operations revolve around her.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: What kind of goal would require Phanuel's powers and a concert of this scale? Why do they need to build her up as the absolute top of the charts, and have all eyes on her? Just what are they trying to achieve...?

You can more or less guess who's orchestrating everything. The problem is, you haven't managed to find anything that can be called a concrete clue. That said, two things are certain from how they're deliberating erasing all traces—for one, they know you very well, and for two, the concert's far from the end of their plan.
Creak. Someone has pushed open the wardrobe door while you're lost in thought.

Whoever it is, their footsteps are light. They pause at the doorway to look around before pulling the door shut. You sense a presence drawing closer from behind. Then, you feel a cold touch at your wrists.
Shh. Eliza's asleep. I told the guards I spotted a suspicious vehicle downstairs to trick them into going away.
It's Phanuel. With no light around to speak of, it takes a while before she finally finds the knot around your wrists.

options: Did you come to release me?
Aren't you afraid Eliza will find out?

steps.content: She seems unprepared for your question, and awkwardly changes the subject.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Does it hurt? The knot around your hands was quite tight... You know, Eliza's never done anything like this before. I swear.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Still defending her? I've got to admit, your manager means more to you than I thought.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: ...I just got my nails done, so this might take a while. Give me a minute.
The mansion is completely silent, making the rustling of fingers working at the ropes strikingly clear.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You do realize what will happen if you untie me, right?

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Hmm... you'll feel better?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: If I make it out of here, your concert and your career will be finished...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Can you really live with that?
The hands working at your bindings hesitate, then go still.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Do you remember the promise we made earlier today...? The ice cream... the taste of summer, the taste of... freedom?
[Eastside Streets]
7 Hours Before Losing Contact

steps.speaker: FAC
steps.content: Do you need assistance? It seems you've been waiting for quite some time.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: No. Your presence could trigger a Mania panic in Eastside. Too many eyes are on Phanuel right now, and the case is still under investigation. Better to keep a low profile.

steps.speaker: Staff Member
steps.content: Coming through, coming through!
A boom mic flies straight toward your face.

You dodge in time. The crew member moves on, hauling equipment through the maze of lighting rigs. Elsewhere, camera dollies are rolling back and forth along their tracks while the director shouts something from behind the monitors. Chaotic, but it's just another day on the film set.

steps.speaker: FAC
steps.content: What did you say? We couldn't hear you.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I said stand by. I'm about to meet Phanuel!

steps.speaker: Staff Member
steps.content: You want to see Phanuel?
The boom mic swings your way again. You sidestep.

steps.speaker: Staff Member
steps.content: I had my eye on you. No badge, no credentials. How'd you sneak in?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I do have credentials, and I've gotten the necessary permits as well. I just need a word with Phanuel. Won't take long.

steps.speaker: Staff Member
steps.content: Another fan who pulled some strings, I bet. Hey, who let this one in?! How many times do I gotta say this—we're on a tight schedule! Do you have any idea how hard it was to book this slot? We can't afford any slip-ups. Come throw this fan out, now!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Wait, hold on—
Before you can get another word in, a concerned voice cuts through the comms.

steps.speaker: FAC
steps.content: Chief, are you in danger? Should we come over?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: It's fine... I've already contacted Phanuel's manager.

steps.speaker: Staff Member
steps.content: Wow, how creative. Can't you people come up with something new? Hey, hello?! I said throw this fan out! We're about to roll, hurry up!

steps.speaker: FAC
steps.content: It sounds quite chaotic on your end. What's going on? The manager... Should we target the manager instead?

steps.speaker: Staff Member
steps.content: "Target"? Wait, are you here to sabotage us?! You with some competing brand or something? Do you have any idea how much money went into this ad? How much effort it took just to get Phanuel for a single shot?!

steps.speaker: FAC
steps.content: It sounds like you're at risk of being removed from the premises. We're ready to assist at any time, so please avoid any direct confrontation with Eastside civilians.
Why the heck did they start chatting cross-platform...? Either way, with the crew closing in to remove you, you have no choice but to pull out your credentials as Chief.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Actually, I'm...

steps.speaker: Staff Member
steps.content: Phanuel's here! I don't have time for this, so stay back, you hear me?
The long boom mic swooshes over your head and plunges straight into the crowd.

Key leader of the West District revolution. Distinguished guest of the Ring Research Institute and the Council. Acting commander of the Black Ring campaign. On paper, you're quite the big deal, yet right now, no one's sparing you so much as a glance. Meanwhile, Phanuel's been completely swarmed.
Just as you're about to make your move, a folder appears in front of you.
Just as you're about to reach out to FAC and adjust your course of action, a folder appears in front of you.
I'm Eliza, Phanuel's manager. Chief of the Minos Bureau of Crisis Control, was it? You're the one who contacted me, right?
She looks you up and down. Your uniform and the Bureau insignia, not exactly a common sight for Eastsiders, draw not so much as a flicker of surprise from her.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Normally, I would've summoned you directly to the Bureau. It's just that, given the nature of Phanuel's work and the fact that I have a few friends who are fans of hers, I thought it'd be worth coming to see things firsthand. Hope that's alright.

steps.speaker: Eliza
steps.content: Of course. It'd be my pleasure to assist. That said, I only have five minutes. I trust you wouldn't disrupt the lives and livelihoods of ordinary citizens over something as insubstantial as rumors?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: That depends on how cooperative you are. Recently, a number of Phanuel's fans have been found in a dazed state with vacant smiles. Online, people have been referring to this as the Hollow Syndrome. Are you aware of this?

steps.speaker: Eliza
steps.content: Yes, and?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: And? Phanuel's concert is right around the corner. Meanwhile, her fans are getting caught up in an anomalous incident. Don't you have anything you want to say?

steps.speaker: Eliza
steps.content: If these "victims" were fans of some other celebrity, perhaps that would be too much of a coincidence. But this is Phanuel we're talking about.

steps.speaker: Eliza
steps.content: The biggest name in Eastside. Someone whose fame reaches all the way from Paradeisos down to the West District. According to the data I have on hand, she even has a following in the Outland.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: What are you getting at?

steps.speaker: Eliza
steps.content: That her fanbase is enormous. Pull ten people off the street and eight of them will be her fans. This "coincidence" provides too small a sample size to prove anything. And as far as I can tell, you don't seem to have any real evidence either, do you?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Looks like we haven't done enough to get our name out there, seeing as you're underestimating us. Unlike the Public Security Bureau, Ms. Eliza, I have an obligation to address any threat to DisCity's safety. Meanwhile... You don't seem willing to cooperate with us?

steps.speaker: Eliza
steps.content: Then, please, feel free to slap cuffs on Eastside's biggest star and haul her back to your turf for questioning. I can clear her entire schedule to accommodate you. But even you're afraid of the optics, no? You're a Chief, after all. The truth matters a lot less than how the system looks. That's just how it is, and you know it.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Then I must have you know I'm quite notorious for having thick skin. I wasn't planning on interrogating you, but I've changed my mind now. I'd love to see where you got this backbone from. Just who is backing you? And who are you covering for?
You're ready to press further, but a clapperboard snaps in the distance.

steps.speaker: Staff Member
steps.content: Cut! That's a wrap! As expected of Phanuel. First take and it's perfect. Adorable. Simply adorable. The effect's brilliant. This ad's gonna be a massive hit!

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: It's all thanks to how hard everyone worked. I hope that everything we've put into this will be recognized by the audience and fans.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: I've also bought all of you some refreshments! I hope you'll keep loving and supporting me in the future! Hope to see you all again soon!
A black van pulls up outside the set just as those sweet parting words fade, and Eliza throws her hands up in resignation.

steps.speaker: Eliza
steps.content: Well, there's your five minutes. I wish you luck with your investigation. I do hope you find the truth soon and give us ordinary citizens the peace of mind we deserve.
Eliza gives a perfunctory bow, then turns to get in the car.
The van pulls away before you can even catch a glimpse of Phanuel. If the crew around you weren't cheerfully dissecting the ad, you'd almost think she hadn't been there at all.
As the van disappears from view, you put in a call to FAC.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Change of plans. Keeping a low profile isn't working. Get me a press pass.

Before the Concert
Media Press Conference

The press conference venue is even more packed than the film set. A long line snakes through the media check-in area, and a forest of camera tripods has claimed every inch of the front rows. By the time you arrive, there's almost nowhere left to stand.

steps.speaker: Reporter A
steps.content: Which outlet are they with? How come they're so late?

steps.speaker: Reporter B
steps.content: Probably just another nobody looking to ride Phanuel's coattails. Won't be the first, won't be the last.

Those words barely come out before a rapid burst of shutters goes off like a string of firecrackers. The entire venue blazes white, bright enough that it's blinding. Through the glare, you can just barely make out a pale figure stepping onto the stage.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Wow... so many people came. Just thinking about how I need to face a whole stadium... makes my heart race. Can you hear it? Thump, thump—

The playful opener draws a ripple of laughter from the crowd, and the mood lifts noticeably. You still haven't gotten a clear look at the stage, but the media parties have already begun firing their questions.

steps.speaker: Reporter A
steps.content: Phanuel, regarding the special setlist prepared exclusively for this concert. Is there anything you can share with us?

steps.speaker: Reporter B
steps.content: Your concert tickets sold out in seconds, and many people online are requesting that you add more dates. Any plans for that?

steps.speaker: Reporters
steps.content: ...Phanuel... Phanuel...
Questions pour in from every direction. Mixed with the noise of shutters, it's impossible to even tell which voice is coming from where.
Then comes a soft tap on the microphone, followed by a gentle clearing of the throat from the stage.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Thank you all for being so enthusiastic. I'll answer your questions one by one.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: First is, of course, the new song prepared specifically for this concert. Since everyone's so curious, Phanuel will reveal a little something: it's going to be something quite different from anything I've done before. We're incorporating a touch of classical music into the mix, so please look forward to it!

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: As for adding more dates, we have no plans for that at the moment. My team and I want to put our heart into this first show before anything else.

You peer through the gaps between heads from the back of the room, trying to get a look at the blurry silhouette on stage. It's hard to find fault with Phanuel's answers, but that doesn't mean they can satisfy the reporters.

steps.speaker: Reporter A
steps.content: Will you be singing live this time, or will there be backing vocals? Do you think your stamina will last for the whole show? Have you done any physical training for this...

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Well, that's something for everyone to look forward to! What I can say is that Phanuel has worked very hard for the sake of my Cherubs!

steps.speaker: Reporter B
steps.content: Some netizens have called you out for never participating in songwriting, saying you're nothing more than a pretty face doing studio covers. Would you like to comment on this?

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: I can understand where they're coming from, and I'm sure they're saying that because they want to see Phanuel grow. I'll keep working hard and learning from my seniors!
Even through the tedium of it all, the reporters keep pushing, hungry for any scrap of Phanuel's attention. Then, a voice cuts through the noise, one that doesn't belong.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Are you aware of a phenomenon called the "Hollow Syndrome?"

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Hmm?
The room goes quiet. The reporters exchange glances. But before they can redirect their attention to you, a figure steps in from the side of the stage and takes the microphone from Phanuel's hand.

steps.speaker: Eliza
steps.content: Apologies, allow me to answer this on Phanuel's behalf. This is something we've already been monitoring internally.

steps.speaker: Eliza
steps.content: I'm sure everyone here knows Phanuel very well. Should she find out something like this has been happening to her fans, she'd be devastated. We'd like to avoid having that affect her performance at the concert.

steps.speaker: Eliza
steps.content: Please rest assured. Mirrormoon Entertainment will offer what support and assistance we can in this matter, regardless of whether there's concrete evidence showing we are responsible. Further details will be announced through our official channels.

steps.speaker: Eliza
steps.content: If there are no further questions, that will be all for today's press conference. Thank you all for coming.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Oh... right! Thank you all so much! I've also bought all of you some refreshments! I hope you'll keep loving and supporting me in the future! Hope to see you all again soon!
Something about that line feels familiar... verbatim, even.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I have one more question about the concert. I'd like Phanuel to answer this one herself.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Regarding the special setlist prepared exclusively for this concert. Is there anything you can share with us?
Your question draws murmurs from the crowd. Phanuel, however, doesn't seem to notice the problem, picking up naturally where she left off.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Phanuel will reveal a little something: it's going to be something quite different from anything I've done before. We're incorporating a touch of classical music into the mix, so please look—

steps.speaker: Eliza
steps.content: This has already been addressed. Phanuel has other matters scheduled, so we must take our leave here. Thank you all.
Phanuel is whisked away immediately. Following such an abrupt ending, the reporters are now buzzing with questions.

steps.speaker: FAC
steps.content: Chief, they left through the back entrance by car.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Follow them. There's something I need to confirm still.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I assumed the manager was using Phanuel's schedule and work as a shield, that she believes we'd hold back with a crowd around. But maybe we're not the ones she's trying to keep out.
[Dressing Room]

steps.speaker: Eliza
steps.content: Don't worry, I've already taken care of it. We'll thoroughly review every article from today's press conference before they can get published.

steps.speaker: Eliza
steps.content: Any outlet that doesn't play ball won't be getting a seat at future interviews. They should know what to do if they truly want the exposure that comes with Phanuel.
The call has barely ended when Eliza's phone rings again.

steps.speaker: Eliza
steps.content: ...Held up in traffic? And? Do you expect me to go sort out the roads myself? Call another backup styling team yourself, unless you don't want this internship anymore.

steps.speaker: Eliza
steps.content: Make it quick. I'll go talk to the director and producer about a contingency plan. See if I can buy you some time for this mess.
Even as Eliza strides out, the other person in the dressing room simply sits in silence, script in hand, waiting to be made up.
Two, three minutes pass. Knock, knock.
A knock comes from outside the dressing room. The person inside doesn't move.
Knock, knock.
The knocking grows more urgent. An unfamiliar voice comes from the other side of the door.
Hello, is Phanuel in? I'm a special guest on today's show. Just wanted to stop by and say hi before we start filming.
Phanuel walks to the door and cracks it open. She studies the stranger carefully, then shakes her head.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: I'm sorry, please contact my manager Eliza for any inquiries—Ah?!
Before the words are even out of her mouth, the visitor slips through the gap with practiced ease, then locks the room from the inside right as the door clicks shut.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Don't worry, I had someone contact your manager. She should be busy dealing with your unreliable styling team right now.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Who are you? ...W-What do you want?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: We've met before, at the press conference. Though with all those camera flashes, it's no surprise you don't remember my face.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: If you have something important to talk about, maybe we should wait for Eliza to come back first?
Panicked, she tries to unlock the door and flee, but you block her way.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: So much for an angel who heals and saves her fans. Now that there's a Mania threat before you, is hiding behind your manager all you can do? Guess the idol persona really is all an act. Wonder how your Cherubs would feel if they knew.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Phanuel doesn't understand what you mean...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Then tell me, what are you without that script? What would you say? What do you know about the Hollow Syndrome?

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Hollow... Syndrome? Phanuel doesn't understand what you're saying at all. If this isn't work-related, please leave. Eliza said I'm not allowed to talk to anyone outside of my schedule.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Really? Or is it that you're just afraid? What if I could make sure your manager never finds out?
The footsteps outside draw closer. This visit was put together last second, so you couldn't really keep Eliza occupied for long.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Answer me, Phanuel. In your own words. Is your schedule really so packed by your own choice? Every question you answered at that press conference, everything you said in front of the camera... Was any of it really your own words?
[Close-up: Phanuel, blank expression]

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Yes. Those were all my own words. Because Phanuel has never said anything that isn't. Never. Because... Phanuel has never said anything else! Those were the only things Phanuel knows...

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Right, the script...
She picks up the variety show script she dropped in the commotion earlier, and reads through it carefully. Every single line.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: You're right. Phanuel does have a script for every single day. I don't think I've ever really thought about it... what would happen if Phanuel wasn't following a script...?
Bang. The dressing room door swings open.
